background.value: Light and plain; no shadows or motifs

head_height.value: 30-36 mm (from top of head to chin)

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and looking directly into camera

glasses_policy.value: Allowed if they do not block eyes; no sunglasses or tinted lenses; no reflections on lenses

headwear_policy.value: Not allowed; religious headgear permitted with forehead, cheekbones and chin visible

face_visibility.value: Whole face must be visible; both eyes visible; looking directly into camera; photo taken from front
